title: Plural negatives: nämä, nuo, ne eivät ole…
summary: Build plural demonstrative statements with eivät ole.
objectives: Place eivät ole after a plural demonstrative subject.
Keep plural subject and negative agreement aligned.
Contrast plural eivät with singular ei.

sections.title: See the pattern
paragraphs: A plural demonstrative subject uses eivät ole.
Eivät carries third-person plural agreement; ole follows without another ending.

sections.title: Use one clear decision
paragraphs: The plural subject may be a demonstrative alone or a supplied demonstrative noun phrase.
Compare singular ei ole with plural eivät ole before producing the sentence.

examples.english: The previously identified cars are not here.
steps: Ne autot: the complete plural subject is supplied.
ole: fixed form after the negative verb.
Nämä talot: the complete plural subject is supplied.
ole: fixed form after the negative verb.
Nuo talot: the complete plural subject is supplied.
ole: fixed form after the negative verb.

commonMistakes: Do not use ei with a plural demonstrative subject.
Do not change the supplied plural noun form.
